title.en: An Act Creating Barrios Polo, Owaon, Burgos, Ba-Ao, Sigayan, Sinonok, Canlucani, Guimputlan, Silinog and Aliguay in the City of Dapitan
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrios Polo, Owaon, Burgos, Ba-Ao, Sigayan, Sinonok, Canlucani, Guimputlan, Silinog and Aliguay in the City of Dapitan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5557_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby created in the City of Dapitan, Barrios Polo, Owaon, Burgos, Ba-ao, Sigayan, Sinonok, Canlucani, Guimputlan, Silinog and Aliguay, their respective boundaries to be determined by the city council with the approval of the city mayor within six months after the approval of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
